Section 39.title: No Responsibility for the act Carried out with Good Faith:
Section 39.content: Notwithstanding anything contained in other places of this Act, a Tax Officer shall not be individually responsible for the act he/she had carried out in pursuance of discharging his/her duties with good faith.
